ruins.name: THE COLOSSEUM (KING'S RUINS)
ruins.desc: Colosseum of fractured obsidian masonry and gladiatorial sand. Center drop zone for Tier-V relic weapons. High skirmish frequency within seconds of drop.

iron-fortress.name: MOUNTAIN CITADEL (IRON FORTRESS)
iron-fortress.desc: High fortified stone bastion towering above the misty crags. Massive gatehouse with portcullis traps and high vantage battlements.

bloodstone.name: CRIMSON BLOODSTONE CANYON
bloodstone.desc: Sunken crimson canyon drenched in bloodstone mists. Unrelenting warrior encounters with volcanic bloodstone veins.

forest.name: WRAITHWOOD (DARK MISTY FOREST)
forest.desc: Ancient petrified pines shrouded in rolling fog. Footstep sound radius is halved, creating the premier drop zone for stealth assassins.

bridge.name: CHASM BRIDGE (ABYSSAL CROSSING)
bridge.desc: Treacherous narrow stone bridge arching over the bottomless abyssal chasm. One mistimed dodge sends opponents into the void.
